methodology.cost_assumption: 6/12/20bp round-trip; no funding or separate spread/slippage
methodology.displacement: MSS directional body >= 0.5 or 0.75 ATR14 and close in directional outer quartile

fvg_definition.bearish: high of MSS candle < low two 15m candles earlier
fvg_definition.bullish: low of MSS candle > high two 15m candles earlier
fvg_definition.entry: limit placed only after MSS close; retracement depth 50% or 75% from proximal FVG edge
fvg_definition.expiry: 8 subsequent 15m candles; unfilled order is cancelled
fvg_definition.same_bar_ambiguity: if a limit fills intrabar and target is also touched in that OHLC candle, no TP credit is given on the fill candle; stop is still honoured

methodology.limitations: 12bp is assumed, not fee-tier verified; no funding or separate spread/slippage; fixed UTC-free session (all hours); mechanical swing/MSS/FVG rules are not discretionary SMC; stop-first OHLC ambiguity; one pending order/position at a time per configuration

selection.train: >=40 trades, net_R>0, PF>=1.05, max DD no worse than -25R, >=50% positive active months
selection.validation: >=20 trades, net_R>0, PF>=1.05, max DD no worse than -15R, >=50% positive active months

methodology.split: chronological 70/15/15; fixed 3/3 pivots and 8-bar MSS wait; 48-entry/exit/filter configurations; train screen, top-10 shortlist, validation; untouched OOS evaluated once only if a candidate passes both gates
methodology.stop: beyond full sweep-to-MSS excursion plus 0 or 0.1 x ATR14 at sweep
methodology.timeframe: 15m execution; 1h confirmed external swing levels; completed 4h EMA regime
